title: Laser lab: a burned wall, structure or seal keeps its laser.ignite cloud; the aim reticle lands in the inset
context: The branch review of the laser lab (517cbcb..3289bb2) found that destroy() fires laser.ignite (about 16 m, with an 8-cell scare) for every wall cell, structure and the seal, which the lab spec did not ask for, and that spec §3's pointer reticle in the satellite inset was never drawn. The owner asked the same day for more explosion and smoke where the beam hits (2026-09-15-laser-lab-feel-owner-notes).
outcome: The ignite on destruction stays: it is the visible payoff of a kill, and it matches the owner's direction toward more explosion on the ground. Its scare also herds the queue away from a breach. 7ae714d draws the aim reticle in the satellite inset on a layer only the satellite camera renders, and clears steering on release so the view holds on the last contact after a lift.
alternatives: Drop the ignite on destruction to keep to the spec's letter; rejected because it removes an explosion the owner has since asked to have more of.
Record the reticle as deferred; rejected because the aim point and the lagging contact are indistinguishable without it now that the contact has inertia (8503f3c).
evidence: npm test green (106 test programs passed) and npm run check green on 7ae714d.
Not browser-verified: the memory guardrail was at WARN. The owner will judge it on the running server, and the --laser step will run when the guardrail clears.
